title: PixelShuffle (TRANSPOSE/RESHAPE lowering) -> zero-stuff + Conv2d

rewrite.from: litert-torch PixelShuffle lowering: TRANSPOSE x8 + RESHAPE chain
rewrite.to: nearest-upsample x mask + Conv2d with shuffle-permutation weights (EDSR recipe)

measurement.probe: probe_ps vs probe_zs (8-conv SR stack, 48ch@160px, two 2x shuffles)
measurement.gpu_control: PixelShuffle form REFUSES to compile on ML Drift; zero-stuff runs 9.8 ms (NPU 1.81x faster)

scope: synthetic SR probe. The zoo's EDSR/Real-ESRGAN already ship the zero-stuff form (adopted for GPU compat) — it is also the NPU-fast form.
notes: The naive PixelShuffle path is both GPU-incompatible and 3x slower on the NPU.
